order.noCardTable: No card on your table? Ask at the counter and we'll take your order there.
order.payCounterWhen: Pay at the counter when you're done — no app, no OTP, no cash-handling here.
order.priceUpdatedTotal: Price updated — the total below is what you'll pay.
order.tapAddAnything: Tap + Add on anything that looks good. It stays here if you switch apps.
order.justSoldOut: Just sold out — remove it to continue.
order.scanTitle: Scan the QR code on your table
order.scanAgainHint: Scan the QR code on your table again — it opens the menu for that table.
order.scanHint: Point your phone's camera at the card on your table. It opens the menu for that table.
order.sendFailed: We couldn't send that. Try again.
order.scanAgain: It's been a while since you scanned. To order, please scan the QR code on your table again.
order.scanToOrder: To order, scan the QR code on your table.
order.demoNotice: Demo mode. Orders are saved in this browser only. Add Firebase keys to .env.local to go live.

confirmation.headBackMenu: Head back to the menu and order again — it'll only take a moment.
confirmation.sendingUpCounter: Sending it up to the counter…
confirmation.mayHaveBeen: It may have been cleared from this device. Ask the counter and we'll take another one.
confirmation.payCounterWhen: Pay at the counter when you're done. Nothing to install, no OTP.
confirmation.counterCouldntAccept: The counter couldn't accept this order
confirmation.pleaseSpeakCounter: Please speak to the counter — they'll sort it out with you.
confirmation.enjoy: Enjoy! Pay at the counter whenever you're ready.
confirmation.bringOver: We'll bring it over. Sit tight, this takes a minute.
confirmation.rejectedNumbered: Order <num>#{number}</num> won't be made, and there's nothing to pay for it.
confirmation.rejectedUnnumbered: Your order won't be made, and there's nothing to pay for it.
confirmation.onItsWay: Order <num>#{number}</num> is on its way to table {table}.
confirmation.noteReady: Ready — a barista is bringing it over.

offline.pageNeedsCafes: This page needs the cafe's wifi. Reconnect and it will load by itself — your basket and your order are safe on this phone.

waiting.waitingCounterConfirm: Waiting for the counter to confirm your table
waiting.nothingDoHere: Nothing to do here. This page updates by itself. Only the first order from your table waits like this.
waiting.glanceOver: Someone at the counter will glance over at table {table} — it usually takes a moment. Your order goes to the kitchen as soon as they confirm.

unreachable.offlineBody: This page needs a connection to load the menu and orders. Check the wifi or mobile data and try again.
unreachable.setupBody: This cafe's site is still being set up. Try again in a minute, or order at the counter.

staff.tapAnywhereSwitch: Tap anywhere to switch the order sound on.
staff.firstOrderTable: First order from a table you haven't confirmed. If someone is sitting there, Accept: it goes to the kitchen and the table stays open for their next orders.
staff.getsNumberWhen: Gets its number when you accept it
staff.leavesBoardCustomers: It leaves the board and the customer's phone says the counter couldn't accept it. This can't be undone.
staff.stepNotAllowed: That step isn't allowed from here — the order may have already moved on.
staff.cantRejectServed: This order can't be rejected any more — it has already been served.
staff.numberingDown: New orders aren't getting today's numbers right now, so they show their older short number instead. Orders still come in as normal. ({message})
staff.newOrdersAppear: New orders appear here the moment a customer taps Place order.

openTables.noneNewGroups: None. A new group's first order waits for you to accept it.
openTables.doWhenGroup: Do it when the group has left: the next order from this table will wait for you to accept it.

totalWarning.totalDoesntMatch: Total doesn't match menu — check before charging

notSetUp.accountIsntSet: Your account isn't set up yet — ask the owner to add you. You are signed in, but this account has not been given a staff role, so the order board stays locked.
notSetUp.inviteLink: The owner can send you an invite link from Owner dashboard → Staff, or run, from the project:

errors.signInMismatch: That email and password don't match.
errors.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again — or ask the owner to reset your password.
errors.signInNetwork: Can't reach the sign-in server. Check the wifi and try again.
errors.userDisabled: This account has been switched off. Ask the owner.
errors.emailSignInOff: Email sign-in isn't switched on for this cafe yet. The owner needs to enable it in the Firebase console.
errors.weakPassword: Pick a longer password: at least 6 characters.
errors.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Enter its password to sign in.
errors.writeDenied: The database refused that change. The order may have already moved on — the board will catch up in a moment.
errors.saveDropped: Couldn't save — the connection dropped. Try again.
errors.saveSlow: Couldn't save — the connection is slow. Try again.
errors.signedOutUpdate: You've been signed out. Sign in again to update orders.
errors.updateFailed: Couldn't update that order. Try again.
errors.readDenied: This account isn't allowed to read past orders. Sign in with the owner account, or check that it has a staff record.
errors.signedOutHistory: You've been signed out. Sign in again to see past orders.
errors.readDropped: Can't reach the database — the connection dropped. Try again.
errors.readSlow: The database took too long to answer. Try again, or pick a shorter range.
errors.quotaUsed: Today's free database allowance is used up. History will load again tomorrow.
errors.teamDenied: The database refused that change. Only an owner can manage the team.
errors.teamGone: That person or invite is already gone.
errors.signedOut: You've been signed out. Sign in again.
errors.inviteRefused: This invite doesn't work any more: it was used, cancelled or has expired. Ask the owner for a new link.
errors.demoMismatch: That email and password do not match.
errors.wrongPin: Wrong PIN. Ask the counter for today's code.
errors.pinDemoOnly: PIN sign-in is a demo-only shortcut. Use your staff email and password.
errors.signInFirst: Sign in with your email first.
errors.signInOwnerFirst: Sign in as the owner first.
errors.inviteGone: This invite link doesn't work any more.
errors.notOnTeam: That person is no longer on the team.
errors.cantReachCafe: Can't reach the cafe right now. Check the connection.

cart.noLongerOnMenu: {name} is no longer on the menu.
cart.tooManyLines: One order can have up to {max} different items — please split it into two orders.
cart.tooManyOfOne: Up to {max} of each item per order.
cart.totalTooHigh: One order can be up to {max} — please split it, or order at the counter.

history.pickBoth: Pick both a start and an end date.
history.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
history.rangeTooLong: That's {days} days. History looks back at most {max} days at a time, so each look stays inside the free database allowance — pick a shorter range, or use Reports for monthly totals.

integrity.totalMismatch: Order says {total}, but its items add up to {sum}.
integrity.priceDiffers: {name}: {ordered} on the order, {menu} on the menu.

throttle.underSeconds: Your last order has only just gone through. You can send another in under {seconds} seconds.

inSeconds.one: Your last order has only just gone through. You can send another in {count} second.
inSeconds.other: Your last order has only just gone through. You can send another in {count} seconds.

placeOrder.scanToOrder: To order, please scan the QR code on your table.
placeOrder.lostTable: We lost track of your table. Please scan again.
placeOrder.notSwitchedOn: Ordering is not switched on yet. Please tell the counter.
placeOrder.noConnection: No connection right now. Check the wifi and try again.
placeOrder.deviceBlocked: This device is not allowed to order. Please scan the code again.
placeOrder.addressNotAllowed: Ordering is not switched on for this address. Please tell the counter.
placeOrder.whoAreYou: We couldn't confirm who you are. Please tell the counter.
placeOrder.orderRefused: We couldn't send that order. Please tell the counter.
placeOrder.kitchenBusy: The kitchen system is busy. Please try again in a moment.
placeOrder.tookTooLong: That took too long. Please try again.
placeOrder.sendFailed: We couldn't send that. Please try again.

tables.wholeNumbers: Table numbers must be whole numbers from 1 to {max}.

dayNumber.exhausted: Every number for {day} is used up ({max} orders).
